The '''Gathering''' was an annual event hosted on [[Sojourn (moon)|Sojourn]] by [[Damask Holdings/Legends|Damask Holdings]]. Some of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] most influential beings were invited to the Hunters' Moon to participate in various debauched but purposeful festivities incorporating obscure ceremonies and rituals in an encampment near [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask's]] [[Damask fortress|fortress]]. While the Gatherings of past generations had simply served as glorified business summits for the financially powerful, particularly under [[Caar Damask]], it was during the reign of kingpin Hego Damask&mdash;the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Darth Plagueis&mdash;that they became infinitely more: a highly complex political tool for shaping gainful alliances and, indeed, the future of the galaxy in accordance to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Grand Plan/Legends|Grand Plan]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

On occasion, the full governing body of the Holdings steering committee met on Sojourn during the Gatherings, as happened for the Gathering of [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]]. 'Magester' Damask at that time, after conferring with Holdings colleagues, held audience with several select individuals and delegations from disparate worlds, including those of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] and [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]&mdash;to create new alliances, or recast sundry secret combinations, for maximum political gain and financial profit. Criminal cartels came to conspire at that time, and were elegantly received by the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[overlord]], including plotting members of the [[Gran Protectorate/Legends|Gran Protectorate]], the [[Yinchorri High Command]], and the colorful entourage of [[Crime lord/Legends|crimelord]] [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla Besadii the Elder]]. Damask's Gatherings continued to be hosted until [[43 BBY/Legends|43 BBY]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gathering appeared in the [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']] written by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />
